findings.title: Ethereum queries do not share an explicitly attributed block height
findings.detail: Fetch a head first, query each account batch at that explicit height, reject duplicate RPC IDs, and disclose multiple query heights rather than implying one wallet-wide snapshot. Remediation commit: bc22b91.
